role.cashier.title: Cashier path
role.cashier.intro: Three short lessons. After them you can sell and close your day alone.
role.owner.title: Owner path
role.owner.intro: Set the shop up first, then try a full day of selling.
guide.open-shift.title: Open your shift
guide.open-shift.why: No sale is recorded before the shift is open.
guide.open-shift.3: Type the amount in the drawer now.
guide.open-shift.5: Done. Your shift is open and you can sell.
guide.open-shift.ok: The word Open shows at the top of the page.
guide.open-shift.mistake: If you typed a wrong amount, close the shift and open it again.
guide.first-sale.title: Your first sale
guide.first-sale.why: This is the most important step of your day.
guide.first-sale.2: Type the item name or scan the barcode.
guide.first-sale.3: You can add more than one item before paying.
guide.first-sale.6: The sale is saved and the receipt printed.
guide.first-sale.ok: The sale shows in today's list.
guide.close-shift.title: Close your shift
guide.close-shift.why: Closing compares the drawer with what the program recorded.
guide.close-shift.3: Count the cash and type the amount.
guide.close-shift.4: Do not look at the expected amount before counting.
guide.close-shift.ok: Any difference shows and is kept in the day's record.
guide.add-product.title: Add an item
guide.add-product.3: Type the item name the way customers know it.
guide.add-product.ok: The item shows in the list.
guide.add-person.title: Add a team member
guide.add-person.why: Each person signs in on their own, with rights that fit their work.
guide.add-person.3: Choose the right role from the list.
guide.add-person.ok: The name shows in the people list.
problem.no-shift.see: A message says: no shift is open.
problem.no-shift.still: If the message stays, report the problem from the Guide button.
problem.drawer-mismatch.see: The cash in the drawer is not the expected amount.
problem.drawer-mismatch.why: A sale may be missing, or wrong change was given.
problem.drawer-mismatch.do.2: Check today's sales on the [[nav.sell]] page.
problem.not-enough-stock.see: A message says: not enough stock.
problem.not-enough-stock.why: The program holds less than you asked for.
problem.not-enough-stock.do.1: Check the item's quantity on the [[nav.stock]] page.
problem.no-permission.see: A message says: you are not allowed.
problem.no-permission.why: Your role does not allow this step.
problem.no-permission.do.1: Ask the owner to give you the right.
